title: refactor: move image fallback routes into their own registry
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `shared/registry/image-fallbacks.ts`: fallback routes keyed by the public model they serve, then by the id each route is registered under — the same key-is-the-id shape as the catalogs they merge into. A route states only its **difference** from its parent (`provider`, `cost`, `billing`)
- Adds `shared/registry/merge-fallbacks.ts`: `mergeFallbacks()` inherits the rest of the parent, stamps `hidden: true`, clears `aliases`, blocks chaining, injects the parent's `fallbacks` list, and inserts each route directly after its parent
- Fallback ids stay hand-declared (`zimage-fal`), not generated: the id is stored in API-key `permissions.models`, so a rename would need a D1 migration
- Types enforce it: a route keyed to a model that doesn't exist fails to compile, and `aliases`/`fallbacks`/`hidden` are `Omit`ed from the route type so they can't be set by hand
- Alternative to the closed #13498, which removed the model identity and needed a permission migration

Verified: the merged registry is value-identical to `main` — all 47 entries deep-compared (functions included) with identical key order, 0 diffs, and the enter effective-prices snapshot passes unmodified. Plus gen + enter typechecks, biome, gen fallback/zimage-fal/model-permissions tests, enter pricing/aliases tests. No file outside `shared/registry/` changes.

gist.headline: Fallbacks found their shelf
gist.blurb: Image fallback routes now live in their own little registry, where they can inherit what they need without pretending to be entirely new flowers. The merged catalog remains exactly the same; the garden labels are just less tangled.
gist.summary: Moved image fallback routes into typed `image-fallbacks.ts` and added `mergeFallbacks()`, which inherits parent model settings while preserving all 47 merged registry entries, ordering, permissions-sensitive fallback IDs, and effective prices unchanged.
gist.impact: Developers get a safer, compile-checked way to define image fallbacks—routes stay next to their parent models in the merged registry without manually duplicating provider, billing, aliases, or visibility fields.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy library-garden registry shelf organizes parent image-model seed packets with their smaller fallback packets placed directly beside them. Polli acts as a careful librarian, filing a clearly labeled fallback card beneath its parent while code-plants grow from the shelves, representing inherited configuration and unchanged model identity.
